title: Post 1 | The Yellow Hours 🚪
style_prompt: liminal empty office space, yellow wallpaper, damp beige carpet, buzzing fluorescent ceiling lights, one bright light source, well exposed, 35mm film grain, no people, no faces, no text, no watermark
hook_text: At 2:41 a.m. my office hallway had one more door than it should.

scenes.narration: At 2:41 a.m. my office hallway had one more door than it should.

shots.prompt: long empty office hallway at night, nine plain doors, one extra beige door glowing under a buzzing ceiling light

scenes.narration: I clean the fourth floor of an empty office building. Nine doors. The same every night.

shots.prompt: empty office corridor at night, cleaning cart parked by the wall, row of nine doors

scenes.narration: That night I counted ten. The tenth had a brass number I had never seen. Zero.

shots.prompt: plain beige office door with a small blank brass plate, cold fluorescent light, no numbers, no digits, no text

scenes.narration: I told myself it was a storage room. I knocked twice. Nothing. The light above it hummed louder.

shots.prompt: close view of a buzzing fluorescent ceiling tube above a plain beige door, dust in the air, no numbers, no text

scenes.narration: I opened it. The hallway behind was yellow. Damp carpet. Lights humming in a line that never ended.

shots.prompt: endless empty hallway with yellow wallpaper and damp beige carpet, long row of fluorescent lights, no people, no windows

scenes.narration: I took one step. The door closed behind me. No click. My own hallway was just gone.

shots.prompt: yellow hallway seen from inside, a plain wall where a door should be, damp carpet, one buzzing light

scenes.narration: Then I heard it. Slow footsteps on wet carpet. Closer every time the light flickered.

shots.prompt: long yellow corridor fading into darkness at the end, lights flickering, wet carpet, empty

scenes.narration: The steps stopped behind the corner. I knew that sound. My cleaning cart. The one I left in my hallway.

shots.prompt: yellow corridor corner with the edge of a cleaning cart and a mop bucket just visible, damp floor, buzzing lights

scenes.narration: Someone was pushing it. Slowly. Toward me. And the wheels were wet.

shots.prompt: cleaning cart wheel leaving wet tracks on yellow carpet in an empty corridor

scenes.narration: I looked down. I was holding the mop. I never picked it up. The door was behind me again. New number. Eleven.

shots.prompt: a plain beige door in a yellow hallway with a blank brass plate, a wet mop leaning on the wall, no numbers, no digits, no text

scenes.narration: So tell me. Do you walk down the hall, or close the door?

shots.prompt: long empty office hallway at night, nine plain doors, one extra beige door glowing under a buzzing ceiling light
